text:
maya: Kicking off onboarding for new org 'orion-ai' — we need a cross-cloud account provisioning checklist for GPU fleets (AWS/GCP/Azure). Goal: 100 GPUs initially across 2 regions, autoscaling, and predictable egress. What quotas, IAM, networking, billing and tags should we request up-front to avoid delays?

samir: +1. High-level: request quotas, service limits, default VPC removal, org-level IAM guardrails, billing export, and ask for spot/preemptible limits. Also request internal support contacts for quota appeals.

linh: Networking notes: reserve /20 per region for node pools, request higher EIP limits on AWS (we spare eips but LB/NAT scaling matters), raise GCP regional static IP quota, and confirm Azure public IP cores. Also request increased network egress caps if applicable (some providers throttle).

jules: IAM & security: create org policies that deny public buckets, set required KMS key policy for model artifacts, enable org-level audit logs to a central logging project/account, and enforce tag inheritance for cost center and environment.

samir: Quota list (start-of-thread checklist):
- GPUs: request target core types (e.g., p4d, a100, h100) + per-region/zone quotas. Ask for both OnDemand and Spot/Preemptible limits.
- vCPU, RAM, and GPUDedicated counts for autoscaler sizing.
- Persistent disks: total PD size and IOPS quotas.
- Network: EIP/public-ip, load balancer quotas, forwarding rules, routes per VPC.
- IAM service accounts: increase service account quota if >100/project.
- GKE/AKS/EKS node pool limits and API rate limits (control-plane quotas).
- COS/Image import quotas if we push many images.
- Inter-region bandwidth soft-limits and cross-AZ bandwidth if applicable.

maya: Do you have a template for quota requests we can paste into support forms?

quota-bot: Template (paste into provider support ticket):
```
Project/Account: <ORION-ORG / project-id>
Requested quota: <resource> e.g., NVIDIA A100 GPUs
Current quota: <number>
Requested quota (per region/zone): <number per region>
Use case: ML inference + training for Redwood Inference customer pilot; expected sustained utilization pattern, bursty deployments, autoscaler enabled
Start date: <yyyy-mm-dd>
Estimated monthly spend: <$X>
Contact (email/phone): <oncall@redwood.com>
Support justification: throughput, low-latency inference, multiregion redundancy
```

linh: Add networking specifics to template: desired subnet CIDR, NAT gateways, VPN throughput, peering requirements, and private service access (GCP) / Private Link (AWS) needs.

jules: Tags & billing: mandatory tags: org, team, product, cost_center, environment, region. Enforce via org policy and deny resources without tags. Enable billing export to BigQuery/S3 and link to cost-management tool.

samir: GCP quick commands we used previously (example):
```
# create project and set billing
gcloud projects create orion-ml-prod --name="orion-ml-prod"
gcloud beta billing projects link orion-ml-prod --billing-account=0123-4567-89AB
# enable APIs
gcloud services enable compute.googleapis.com container.googleapis.com iam.googleapis.com
```

maya: Any regional constraints we should call out for GPUs? I.e., prefer a100 in us-west2 but fallback to us-central1?

samir: Yes — explicitly request soft quotas in primary + fallback regions. In ticket: list preferred regions then fallback order. Ask providers to unlock specific zones as needed for high-memory instances (some zones reserve for special hardware).

linh: Also ask for accelerated networking features enabled on instances (SR-IOV/ENA) and confirm NIC limits for large node sizes — otherwise we hit pod density limits.

jules: Also: certs & KMS — request org KMS quota and HSM-backed keys if enterprise. Put a note to security to pre-approve key policies before we ship.

maya: This is great. I'll open requests today. Can someone review the ticket text before I submit? cc @samir @linh @jules :thumbsup:

samir: Happy to review — send draft here.

linh: Will double-check network CIDRs and egress numbers.

jules: I'll validate tag enforcement and logging routes.

quota-bot: FYI — saved a checklist copy to /docs/onboarding/cross-cloud-account-checklist.md (internal).

maya: Thanks all — aiming to have all quota requests submitted by EOD so provisioning can start next week.
